answer: NovaOps's equipment policy states that personal laptops are not allowed for employees, except for a five-business-day IT continuity exception when a managed laptop is being repaired or replaced and the employee has no working device. IT must approve and log the exception before the employee uses a personal machine, even for those five days. All equipment remains NovaOps property and must be returned through IT at offboarding or role change​​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops]​​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Care and return].

During the five-business-day IT continuity exception, IT must approve and log the exception before the employee uses a personal machine, even for those five days. This means you cannot just go ahead; IT approval is required​​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops].
